features.name: Swashbuckler Finesse
features.summary: Gain Weapon Finesse benefits with light and one-handed piercing melee weapons and use Charisma for combat-feat Intelligence prerequisites.

features.name: Panache
features.summary: Begin each day with Charisma-modifier panache and regain points through critical hits and killing blows.

features.name: Deeds
features.summary: Spend or retain panache to use derring-do, dodging panache, opportune parry and riposte, and precise strike.

features.name: Charmed Life
features.summary: Before a saving throw, add Charisma to the result; daily uses increase every 4 levels.

features.name: Nimble
features.summary: Gain +1 dodge AC in light or no armour; improves by +1 every 4 levels.

features.name: Swashbuckler Weapon Training
features.summary: Gain +1 attack and damage with light or one-handed piercing melee weapons and Improved Critical at level 9.

features.name: Advanced Deeds
features.summary: Unlock superior feint, targeted strike, and swashbuckler's grace.

features.name: Greater Deeds
features.summary: Unlock bleeding wound, evasive, subtle blade, and swashbuckler's initiative.

features.name: Master Deeds
features.summary: Unlock dizzying defence, perfect thrust, and swashbuckler's edge.

features.name: Swashbuckler Weapon Mastery
features.summary: Automatically confirm critical threats with qualifying weapons and increase their critical multiplier.
